title: The codec's input noise — 2026-10-12
meta: 2026-10-12 · repeat of the run above: LIN1 shorted to the codec's own GND, only vip and the codec connected
intro: This is the WM8960 codec on its jumpers to the Core host with its input shorted at the pin, so the converter sees silence: everything in these captures is the pedal's own noise, and nothing in them is the guitar, the input board or the room. Each arm is 20 s of the codec's own ADC, analysed from 2 s in, because the stream's start-up transient sits in the first seconds.
The state line above is the owner's description of the bench, not something this script can see: it measured whatever was wired, and only the numbers below say how quiet that was.
callout: How to read it. Each capture has a spectrum in dBFS per 0.73 Hz bin and the same noise as octave-band bars. Hum is a spike at 50 Hz and its harmonics; hiss is a broad slope across the high bands. The two arms that matter are the engine's own recording (the pedal's normal state) and the one with a silent playback stream open (the converter's quiet state).
footer: Captured by scripts/codec-input-noise.py, analysed and drawn by scripts/codec-noise.py and scripts/noise-document.py. The engine and host state around the run is in state.json.

captures.label: Engine running, muted — the pedal's normal state
captures.note: The engine holds the codec and renders its document, muted, which is what the player's audio path carries. Captured through namchainctl record: the engine's own capture path, the one the bench test's “Guitar input noise” uses. 2026-10-11 read −75.3 dBFS(A) here at 64-frame periods.

captures.label: Engine stopped, a silent playback stream open
captures.note: No engine, but a silent aplay holds the playback path open — the codec state the engine leaves it in. This converter's capture-only state is about 15 dB louder in the 4–16 kHz bands, so this arm is the quiet one: 2026-10-11 read −79.9 dBFS(A).

captures.label: Engine stopped, capture only (no playback stream)
captures.note: The engine stopped and arecord on its own. The arm the earlier logs quote, and the least repeatable of the three: 2026-10-11 read −75.8 dBFS(A) in the settled re-run, but 4–16 kHz dominated and 15 dB louder with the Pico attached earlier the same day.
